actions.clear-queue.description: Clears all items inside a queue
actions.clear-queue.props.info.descripti:
**Note:**
- This deletes all items inside the queue permanently.
- Queues are shared across the project: any flow using the same queue name reads and writes the same queue. A queue holds up to 512 KB of items.
- Testing this single step uses a separate test queue. Test Flow and published runs use the real queue.
- Use one flow run at a time per queue: runs that push or pull the same queue at the same moment can lose items or receive the same item twice.
actions.clear-queue.props.queueName.desc: The name of the queue. Every flow in the project that uses the same name shares the same queue. Up to 110 characters in flow runs, or 102 when testing this step on its own.
actions.get-queue-size.description: Count the items waiting in a queue
actions.get-queue-size.props.info.descri:
**Note:**
- Counts the items waiting in the queue without reading or removing them. A queue that was never used counts as empty.
- Queues are shared across the project: any flow using the same queue name reads and writes the same queue. A queue holds up to 512 KB of items.
- Testing this single step uses a separate test queue. Test Flow and published runs use the real queue.
- Use one flow run at a time per queue: runs that push or pull the same queue at the same moment can lose items or receive the same item twice.
actions.get-queue-size.props.queueName.d: The name of the queue. Every flow in the project that uses the same name shares the same queue. Up to 110 characters in flow runs, or 102 when testing this step on its own.
actions.peek-queue.description: Read the oldest items in a queue without removing them
actions.peek-queue.props.info.descriptio:
**Note:**
- Returns the oldest items in the queue without removing them, plus the total number of items queued.
- Queues are shared across the project: any flow using the same queue name reads and writes the same queue. A queue holds up to 512 KB of items.
- Testing this single step uses a separate test queue. Test Flow and published runs use the real queue.
- Use one flow run at a time per queue: runs that push or pull the same queue at the same moment can lose items or receive the same item twice.
actions.peek-queue.props.numOfItems.desc: How many items to read from the front of the queue (a whole number, 0 or more). Defaults to 1.
actions.peek-queue.props.queueName.descr: The name of the queue. Every flow in the project that uses the same name shares the same queue. Up to 110 characters in flow runs, or 102 when testing this step on its own.
actions.pull-from-queue.props.info.descr:
**Note:**
- Pulled items are removed from the queue right away, oldest first. If a later step fails, they are not put back.
- Fewer items come back when the queue holds fewer than requested, and none when it is empty.
- Queues are shared across the project: any flow using the same queue name reads and writes the same queue. A queue holds up to 512 KB of items.
- Testing this single step uses a separate test queue. Test Flow and published runs use the real queue.
- Use one flow run at a time per queue: runs that push or pull the same queue at the same moment can lose items or receive the same item twice.
actions.pull-from-queue.props.numOfItems: How many items to take from the front of the queue (a whole number, 0 or more).
